questions.q: In which year did Cyborg make his first appearance, in a preview insert of DC Comics Presents #26?
questions.why: Cyborg debuted in a preview insert in DC Comics Presents #26 (October 1980), ahead of the New Teen Titans relaunch.

questions.q: Which writer and artist created Cyborg?
questions.why: Marv Wolfman and George Pérez created Victor Stone for their New Teen Titans relaunch.
Cyborg is Victor Stone, a genius and athlete rebuilt with cybernetic parts after a near-fatal accident.

questions.q: Who played Cyborg in the 2017 film Justice League?
questions.why: Ray Fisher portrayed Victor Stone across Batman v Superman, the 2017 Justice League and the Snyder Cut.

questions.q: In the classic comic origin, who rebuilds the dying Victor with cybernetic parts?
questions.why: His estranged father, Silas, used his prosthetics research to save Victor after the lab accident.

questions.q: In the New 52 revamp, Victor was a star athlete in which sport before his accident?
questions.why: The New 52 origin makes Victor a high-school football star sought after by scouts, and his relationship with his father is strained.

questions.q: In the comics, Cyborg's father works as a scientist at which lab?
questions.why: Silas works as a top scientist at S.T.A.R. Labs, and his research is linked to Victor's accident.

questions.q: Which childhood friend of Victor later gets similar implants and turns into his enemy?
questions.why: Ron Evers, Victor's friend who led him into trouble, was given implants after an injury and later sought revenge on him.

questions.q: Pérez said Cyborg's half-metallic face was inspired by which Marvel character?
questions.why: Pérez cited Rich Buckler's Deathlok as the inspiration for Cyborg's head and metal face plate.

questions.q: Who played Cyborg in the TV series Smallville?
questions.why: Lee Thompson Young played the Smallville version, which was Cyborg's live-action debut.
